format_valid.definition: strict parser accepts exactly one reasoning block followed by one terminal answer block

valid_answer_component_rate.definition: flat RewardEvaluation.valid_answer_component is greater than zero
valid_answer_component_rate.note: domain-valid extracted-answer shaping probe; not canonical parseability

parseable.definition: canonical status is wrong_answer or verified_pass

canonical_pass.denominator: all candidates for candidate rate; problem universes for pass metrics

eos.definition: last real completion token equals tokenizer EOS id 151645

truncated.definition: runtime primary-evidence truncated flag; completion reached the 256-token cap without EOS

pass4_duplicate_rate.definition: sum over independent pass4 groups of (4 - number of unique exact completion texts) divided by 400 candidates
